profiles.label: Profiles
profiles.help: Identities the bot can speak under: a name, and a picture. The bot posts through a channel webhook — the message carries that name and picture, with the « BOT » tag Discord adds and that cannot be removed. With no picture, the bot's own avatar is used. Not a real member: do not impersonate someone.
